messages:
harry (eng-sre): Postmortem INC-2001 published. Root cause: KV cache eviction spiral combined with autoscaler decision delay. We need a compact runbook edit set + owners.

harry (eng-sre): Proposed short list (aiming to ship this sprint):
- Add a KV triage decision gate: inbound rate, eviction rate, and prefix fullness checks (owner: tasha, due: 2025-09-10)
- Add a containment 'safe-rate-limit' route with exact commands + quick diag dump (owner: eun, due: 2025-09-12)
- Explicit autoscaler-degradation escalation + decision matrix if scaler fails (owner: mike, due: 2025-09-09)
- Make runbook idempotent: automated checklist that the oncall can run to mark steps done (owner: tasha, due: 2025-09-14)

tasha (eng-platform): I'll own the triage gate and the automated checklist. Plan: two quick queries (hit_ratio < 0.6, eviction_rate > 50/min) and a link to a one-click fallback toggle.

eun (eng-runtime): Taking containment. Draft snippet for runbook (copy/paste friendly). Will include example outputs for grepping: 

```
# safe-rate-limit: drop traffic to inference route and set readonly cache
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference patch svc inference-api -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
# diag: recent evictions + per-prefix fullness
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/inference-api -- python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=40 | jq '.prefixes[] | {prefix, filled_ratio, last_evicted_at}'
```

eun (eng-runtime): I'll add expected output snips in the PR so oncall can grep for `filled_ratio` and `last_evicted_at`.

mike (infra): For autoscaler failures we should have a decision matrix: if scaler didn't add pods in X seconds -> escalate to @platform-pager and apply safe-rate-limit; if scaling happens but eviction continues -> flip cache TTL to longer defaults and engage runtime for deeper triage. I'll add exact timings and contact rotations.

harry (eng-sre): Good. Also add a short troubleshooting subsection: "quick checks before paging" (eg check controller-manager logs, k8s events, and autoscaler metrics). Keep all commands non-destructive where possible.

tasha (eng-platform): I'll wire the triage gate to the automated checklist so the runbook can be run as a small playbook in the console. That should reduce handoffs.

ops-bot: NOTE: temp incident tag added: recurring-pattern=kv-eviction. This will surface in monthly digest.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook PR created by tasha: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-2001-triage-draft PR #834. Assigning eun and mike for review.

eun (eng-runtime): One more optional item: add a short "containment rollback" snippet in case safe-rate-limit makes latency unacceptable. Keep rollback steps atomic.

tasha (eng-platform): Good call. I'll include rollback commands and a small risk note.

mike (infra): scheduling a 20m walkthrough with oncall and platform to run through the checklist and decision matrix: 2025-09-11 16:00 UTC. Setting a calendar invite.

harry (eng-sre): I'll create follow-up tasks for monthly trend review and set the recurring 30d check to confirm whether pattern persists. Owners: tasha for runbook, eun for diagnostics, mike for escalation matrix.

tasha (eng-platform): After walkthrough I'll merge and tag runbook header with postmortem link and recurring-pattern.

harry (eng-sre): Thanks everyone. If anyone needs to shift dates, reply here. Closing thread after PR is merged and walkthrough is complete. :thumbsup:
